warnings: Experimental PCM-enhanced routine: CH1/2 SID + CH3 volume digi, PAL, ~4 kHz / 4-bit. CH3 returns to synthesis for ordinary notes. One tracker channel can contain PCM notes.
Channel mapping: tracker CH1 -> C64 CH3, tracker CH2 -> C64 CH1, tracker CH3 -> C64 CH2. The editable project is unchanged.
Volume digis modulate the other SID voices; 6581/8580 levels and distortion differ. Instruction timing is verified; physical C64 listening and VIC/CIA integration need hardware testing.
3 unique sample renders, 1,242 packed bytes. CIA1 timer A, CIA2 timer A/NMI, CH3, $F8/$F9 and RAM $0801..$CFFF are owned during replay.
